title: A Chain of Love, Passed On
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A song says, 'Do not hide these things
From little ones, but tell
The children all the mighty works
Of God who loves them well.'

[Chorus]
So tell the children, tell them all
The good things God has done,
And they will tell their children too,
A chain of love begun.

[Verse 2]
The children grow up knowing God,
And when they're big and tall,
They tell their children, on and on,
The stories reach us all.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes; each story heard
Makes you a link of love,
Some day you'll tell it, too, but now
Sleep, held by God above.

[Chorus]
mood: Walking music. A steady, walking sway that hands each phrase to the next like a story passed from lap to lap, matching a story about grown-ups telling children and children telling theirs. The pulse is warm and sure, with a gentle swell on the chorus. By the last verse it slows and settles lower, the walk becoming a rock, as the story is tucked in for the night.
